root_cause_label: Incomplete Task Execution - No End-to-End Git Push Validation
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent set up the bare git repository, post-receive hook, and web server but never performed the required end-to-end git push workflow, so hello.html was never deployed to /var/www/html and the grading test fails.
t_err_evidence: From step 1, the agent's plan explicitly enumerates six steps (install git, create bare repo, add hook, set permissions, start web server, sanity-check server) but never includes cloning the repo, committing hello.html, and pushing to trigger the deployment hook — the only way hello.html can appear in /var/www/html.
t_commit_evidence: At step 17, the agent issues 'curl -s http://localhost:8080/index.html || true' and the LLM step analysis labels this as 'service validation', completing the first full setup cycle. At this point the agent has done everything it planned and makes no further reference to performing a git push. Outcome is locked: no subsequent step introduces the end-to-end push.
trigger_explanation: The task requires that hello.html be present in the web root after a git push, which means the agent must itself perform a clone-commit-push cycle (or pre-seed the repo) to satisfy the grading test. The agent's plan in step 1 treats the git push as an external client action and never includes it as an agent step, so the critical file deployment is simply omitted throughout the trajectory.
